public.text: Semantic content alongside exchange format — Introduces ICD-11 in an actual interoperability role at the first explanation of why health needs more than transport. Evidence: WHO clinical documentation hub (https://www.who.int/standards/classifications/clinician-documentation-hub).
public.suggestedRevision: Insert sentence group: The exchange format must be combined with an agreed clinical information model and identified semantic content. For example, ICD-11 can supply the terminology used to record and exchange a diagnosis and the classification used to report it, with the original clinical detail retained. FHIR supplies an exchange representation; it does not, by itself, select or replace that semantic content.
